title: Visual builder JS split shortcuts context menu

entries.summary: Split editor.js into ns/history/model/canvas/layers/dnd/actions/panel/save/ui plus boot. Added shortcuts overlay, canvas context menu, layers filter, and sessionStorage for zoom/device/Layers.
No schema change. sessionStorage prefs are tab-local and not in ZIP backups. Layouts still live in layout_json.
cms-builder-drag-column-size.spec.ts opens the shortcuts dialog via the ? toolbar button.
